description: Implementation of the IAudioManager interface, including methods for tracking and managing audio players and recorders, within the Android media framework.

classes.name: BpAudioManager
classes.description: Proxy class implementing IAudioManager interface for IPC communication with the audio service.

methods.name: trackPlayer
methods.description: Starts tracking an audio player, returns a unique ID.

methods.name: playerAttributes
methods.description: Sets attributes for a specific audio player.

methods.name: playerEvent
methods.description: Sends an event to a specific audio player.

methods.name: releasePlayer
methods.description: Releases tracking of an audio player.

methods.name: trackRecorder
methods.description: Starts tracking an audio recorder, returns a unique ID.

methods.name: recorderEvent
methods.description: Sends an event to a specific audio recorder.

methods.name: releaseRecorder
methods.description: Releases tracking of an audio recorder.

methods.name: playerSessionId
methods.description: Associates a session ID with a player.

methods.name: portEvent
methods.description: Sends an event related to an audio port.
